models_evaluated: SAGE (LLM planning agent), non-reasoning model variant

links.outcome: Presence of deliberative behaviors in agent reasoning traces, reasoning versus non-reasoning model
links.effect: Reasoning agent showed prospective constraint verification (457 instances) and trade-off deliberation (609 instances) versus 0 and 7 instances for the standard model; traces serve as auditable logs.
links.quote: When prompted to improve conformity, the reasoning model demonstrated systematic planning behaviors including prospective constraint verification (457 instances) and trade-off deliberation (609 instances), while the standard model exhibited none of these deliberative processes (0 and 7 instances, respectively).

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM-based agent (SAGE) for stereotactic radiosurgery planning on a retrospective cohort, comparing a reasoning vs. non-reasoning model variant to evaluate systematic constraint verification, trade-off deliberation, and auditable logging.

primary.practice: chain-of-thought reasoning and auditable logs for constraint verification
